description: Canonical JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for charts/lenny/values.yaml, generated from pkg/chart/values. spec: §17.6.

capabilityTokenTtlSeconds.description: §10.2 default lifetime of the Lenny-issued JWTs whose holder refreshes them: playground bearers and POST /v1/oauth/token JWTs requested without expires_in. Bounded 120..3600.

cluster.description: Cluster-type composition dimension (laptop, eks, gke, aks, openshift, or vanilla).

environment.description: Target environment (local, dev, staging, or prod): prod is production mode, which turns on every production gate in every Lenny binary; staging is not production mode. Also sets alert thresholds, warm-pool sizes, and log verbosity (§17.6 question phase, §17.9.1).

deploymentTier.description: Static metric tier label and lenny-ops platform tier: tier1, tier2, or tier3. §16.1.1, §25.4.

devMode.description: Relaxes multi-tenant admission controls for local development. Never enable on a multi-tenant cluster. §4.9.

maintenanceMode.description: When true, the §25.6 doctor --fix auto-remediation surface skips every remediation.

noEnvironmentPolicy.description: Platform-wide default access policy for a session that names no environment. §10.6.

saTokenAudience.description: Projected SA-token audience the gateway validates on every pod→gateway request. §10.3.

spiffeTrustDomain.description: SPIFFE trust domain anchoring agent-pod and interceptor identities. Required (no default); helm templating fails when unset. §10.3.

traceSamplingRate.description: Default probabilistic tail-sampling rate the OpenTelemetry Collector applies to normal traces. §16.3.

isolation.description: Removed. Set the RuntimeClass name of a profile with runtimeClasses.profiles.<profile>.name; the chart refuses to render when any isolation key is set. §17.5.

isolationProfile.description: Isolation-profile composition dimension (baseline, sandboxed, or hypervisor): sets the default RuntimeClass for seeded runtimes.

signQuotaPerSecond.description: §17.8.2 provider asymmetric KMS Sign quota per second. No default; required when kms.provider is not local.

name.description: Shared OpenSLO AlertNotificationTarget name; renders into pattern-constrained metadata.name and targetRef fields.

acknowledgeApiKeyMode.description: Acknowledges the §27.9 paste-form phishing surface for authMode=apiKey outside dev mode.

allowedRuntimes.description: Comma-separated glob list of runtime IDs the playground runtime picker offers. Default is every visible runtime.

devTenantId.description: Tenant bound to every dev-mode playground token; applies only when authMode is dev. §27.3.

enabled.description: Turns the §27 playground on. Off by default.

gatewayHost.description: Public gateway host the playground UI connects to over the MCP WebSocket. §27.7 connect-src CSP.

maxIdleTimeSeconds.description: §27.6 hard idle-timeout override for a playground-initiated session.

maxSessionMinutes.description: §27.6 hard cap on a playground-initiated session's active time, which pauses while the session is suspended.

oidcSessionTtlSeconds.description: Lifetime of the §27.3.1 server-side playground session record and its cookie.

sessionLabels.description: §27.2 operator-tunable label map stamped on every playground session record and audit event.

title: Lenny Helm chart values
